name: mx-workflow
description: Development workflow plugin with commands and agents for the full dev lifecycle: ticket intake, planning, implementation, quality checks, conventional commits, MR creation, batch AI implementation, and multi-agent team builds.
author: Josh Tune

commands.name: prime
commands.description: Warm up codebase context (reads key files, runs checks)

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show project status and available tools

commands.name: rca
commands.description: Deep root cause analysis (5 Whys + git history)

commands.name: implement
commands.description: Execute plan with validation + agent review

commands.name: commit
commands.description: Create conventional commits with AI-assisted messages

commands.name: ship
commands.description: Create merge/pull request and handle CI/CD

commands.name: build-with-agent-team
commands.description: Batch AI implementation with multi-agent collaboration

commands.name: check-ignores
commands.description: Verify gitignore and similar ignore patterns

commands.name: help
commands.description: Quick reference for all workflow commands

agents.name: mx-code-reviewer
agents.description: Review code for adherence to project guidelines, style guides, and best practices

agents.name: mx-code-simplifier
agents.description: Analyze and simplify code for improved readability and efficiency

agents.name: mx-comment-analyzer
agents.description: Analyze comments and documentation for clarity and accuracy

agents.name: mx-mr-test-analyzer
agents.description: Analyze test coverage and quality in merge requests

agents.name: mx-silent-failure-hunter
agents.description: Identify potential silent failures and edge cases in code

agents.name: mx-type-design-analyzer
agents.description: Analyze type definitions and design patterns
